items.text: How Samuel When He Was So Infirm With Old Age That He Could Not Take Care Of The Public Affairs Intrusted Them To His Sons; And How Upon The Evil Administration Of The Government By Them The Multitude Were So Angry, That They Required To Have A King To Govern Them, Although Samuel Was Much Displeased Thereat.
items.text_de: Wie Samuel, als er vor Alter so gebrechlich war, dass er sich nicht mehr um die öffentlichen Angelegenheiten kümmern konnte, sie seinen Söhnen anvertraute; und wie die Menge über deren schlechte Amtsführung so erzürnt war, dass sie einen König verlangte, der sie regieren sollte, obwohl Samuel darüber sehr unwillig war.
items.text_en: How Samuel When He Was So Infirm With Old Age That He Could Not Take Care Of The Public Affairs Intrusted Them To His Sons; And How Upon The Evil Administration Of The Government By Them The Multitude Were So Angry, That They Required To Have A King To Govern Them, Although Samuel Was Much Displeased Thereat.

items.text: The Appointment Of A King Over The Israelites, Whose Name Was Saul; And This By The Command Of God.
items.text_de: Die Einsetzung eines Königs über die Israeliten namens Saul, und zwar auf Gottes Befehl.
items.text_en: The Appointment Of A King Over The Israelites, Whose Name Was Saul; And This By The Command Of God.

items.text: Saul's Expedition Against The Nation Of The Ammonites And Victory Over Them And The Spoils He Took From Them.
items.text_de: Sauls Feldzug gegen das Volk der Ammoniter, sein Sieg über sie und die Beute, die er ihnen abnahm.
items.text_en: Saul's Expedition Against The Nation Of The Ammonites And Victory Over Them And The Spoils He Took From Them.

items.text: How The Philistines Made Another Expedition Against The Hebrews And Were Beaten.
items.text_de: Wie die Philister einen weiteren Feldzug gegen die Hebräer unternahmen und geschlagen wurden.
items.text_en: How The Philistines Made Another Expedition Against The Hebrews And Were Beaten.

items.text: Saul's War With The Amalekites, And Conquest Of Them.
items.text_de: Sauls Krieg gegen die Amalekiter und ihre Unterwerfung.
items.text_en: Saul's War With The Amalekites, And Conquest Of Them.

items.text: How, Upon Saul's Transgression Of The Prophet's Commands, Samuel Ordained Another Person To Be King Privately, Whose Name Was David, As God Commanded Him.
items.text_de: Wie Samuel, nachdem Saul die Gebote des Propheten übertreten hatte, insgeheim einen anderen namens David zum König bestimmte, wie Gott es ihm befahl.
items.text_en: How, Upon Saul's Transgression Of The Prophet's Commands, Samuel Ordained Another Person To Be King Privately, Whose Name Was David, As God Commanded Him.

items.text: How The Philistines Made Another Expedition Against The Hebrews Under The Reign Of Saul; And How They Were Overcome By David's Slaying Goliath In Single Combat.
items.text_de: Wie die Philister unter der Regierung Sauls einen weiteren Feldzug gegen die Hebräer unternahmen; und wie sie dadurch überwunden wurden, dass David Goliat im Zweikampf tötete.
items.text_en: How The Philistines Made Another Expedition Against The Hebrews Under The Reign Of Saul; And How They Were Overcome By David's Slaying Goliath In Single Combat.

items.text: Saul Envies David For His Glorious Success, And Takes An Occasion Of Entrapping Him, From The Promise He Made Him Of Giving Him His Daughter In Marriage; But This Upon Condition Of His Bringing Him Six Hundred Heads Of The Philistines.
items.text_de: Saul beneidet David um seinen glänzenden Erfolg und nimmt das Versprechen, ihm seine Tochter zur Frau zu geben, zum Anlass, ihm eine Falle zu stellen; jedoch unter der Bedingung, dass er ihm sechshundert Köpfe von Philistern bringe.
items.text_en: Saul Envies David For His Glorious Success, And Takes An Occasion Of Entrapping Him, From The Promise He Made Him Of Giving Him His Daughter In Marriage; But This Upon Condition Of His Bringing Him Six Hundred Heads Of The Philistines.

items.text: How David, Upon Saul's Laying Snares For Him, Did Yet Escape The Dangers He Was In By The Affection And Care Of Jonathan And The Contrivances Of His Wife Michal: And How He Came To Samuel The Prophet.
items.text_de: Wie David, als Saul ihm nachstellte, dennoch durch die Zuneigung und Fürsorge Jonathans und die List seiner Frau Michal den Gefahren entkam, in denen er schwebte; und wie er zum Propheten Samuel kam.
items.text_en: How David, Upon Saul's Laying Snares For Him, Did Yet Escape The Dangers He Was In By The Affection And Care Of Jonathan And The Contrivances Of His Wife Michal: And How He Came To Samuel The Prophet.

items.text: How David Fled To Ahimelech And Afterwards To The Kings Of The Philistines And Of The Moabites, And How Saul Slew Ahimelech And His Family.
items.text_de: Wie David zu Ahimelech und danach zu den Königen der Philister und der Moabiter floh und wie Saul Ahimelech und seine Familie tötete.
items.text_en: How David Fled To Ahimelech And Afterwards To The Kings Of The Philistines And Of The Moabites, And How Saul Slew Ahimelech And His Family.

items.text: How David, When He Had Twice The Opportunity Of Killing Saul Did Not Kill Him. Also Concerning The Death Of Samuel And Nabal.
items.text_de: Wie David, als er zweimal die Gelegenheit hatte, Saul zu töten, ihn nicht tötete. Ferner über den Tod Samuels und Nabals.
items.text_en: How David, When He Had Twice The Opportunity Of Killing Saul Did Not Kill Him. Also Concerning The Death Of Samuel And Nabal.

items.text: Now Saul Upon God's Not Answering Him Concerning The Fight With The Philistines Desired A Necromantic Woman To Raise Up The Soul Of Samuel To Him; And How He Died, With His Sons Upon The Overthrow Of The Hebrews In Battle.
items.text_de: Saul bittet, als Gott ihm wegen des Kampfes mit den Philistern keine Antwort gibt, eine Totenbeschwörerin, ihm die Seele Samuels heraufzuholen; und wie er mit seinen Söhnen bei der Niederlage der Hebräer in der Schlacht starb.
items.text_en: Now Saul Upon God's Not Answering Him Concerning The Fight With The Philistines Desired A Necromantic Woman To Raise Up The Soul Of Samuel To Him; And How He Died, With His Sons Upon The Overthrow Of The Hebrews In Battle.

items.text: How David Reigned Over One Tribe At Hebron While The Son Of Saul Reigned Over The Rest Of The Multitude; And How, In The Civil War Which Then Arose Asahel And Abner Were Slain.
items.text_de: Wie David in Hebron über einen Stamm herrschte, während der Sohn Sauls über die übrige Menge herrschte; und wie in dem Bürgerkrieg, der damals ausbrach, Asaël und Abner getötet wurden.
items.text_en: How David Reigned Over One Tribe At Hebron While The Son Of Saul Reigned Over The Rest Of The Multitude; And How, In The Civil War Which Then Arose Asahel And Abner Were Slain.

items.text: That Upon The Slaughter Of Ishbosheth By The Treachery Of His Friends, David Received The Whole Kingdom.
items.text_de: Dass David nach der Ermordung Isch-Boschets durch den Verrat seiner Freunde das ganze Königreich erhielt.
items.text_en: That Upon The Slaughter Of Ishbosheth By The Treachery Of His Friends, David Received The Whole Kingdom.

items.text: How David Laid Siege To Jerusalem; And When He Had Taken The City, He Cast The Canaanites Out Of It, And Brought In The Jews To Inhabit Therein.
items.text_de: Wie David Jerusalem belagerte und, nachdem er die Stadt eingenommen hatte, die Kanaaniter daraus vertrieb und die Juden darin ansiedelte.
items.text_en: How David Laid Siege To Jerusalem; And When He Had Taken The City, He Cast The Canaanites Out Of It, And Brought In The Jews To Inhabit Therein.

items.text: That When David Had Conquered The Philistines Who Made War Against Him At Jerusalem, He Removed The Ark To Jerusalem And Had A Mind To Build A Temple.
items.text_de: Dass David, nachdem er die Philister besiegt hatte, die bei Jerusalem gegen ihn Krieg führten, die Lade nach Jerusalem überführte und einen Tempel bauen wollte.
items.text_en: That When David Had Conquered The Philistines Who Made War Against Him At Jerusalem, He Removed The Ark To Jerusalem And Had A Mind To Build A Temple.

items.text: How David Brought Under The Philistines, And The Moabites, And The Kings Of Sophene And Of Damascus, And Of The Syrians As Also The Idumeans, In War; And How He Made A League With The King Of Hamath; And Was Mindful Of The Friendship That Jonathan, The Son Of Saul, Had Borne Him.
items.text_de: Wie David die Philister, die Moabiter, die Könige von Sophene und von Damaskus sowie die Syrer und auch die Idumäer im Krieg unterwarf; und wie er mit dem König von Hamat ein Bündnis schloss und der Freundschaft gedachte, die Jonathan, der Sohn Sauls, ihm erwiesen hatte.
items.text_en: How David Brought Under The Philistines, And The Moabites, And The Kings Of Sophene And Of Damascus, And Of The Syrians As Also The Idumeans, In War; And How He Made A League With The King Of Hamath; And Was Mindful Of The Friendship That Jonathan, The Son Of Saul, Had Borne Him.

items.text: How The War Was Waged Against The Ammonites And Happily Concluded.
items.text_de: Wie der Krieg gegen die Ammoniter geführt und glücklich beendet wurde.
items.text_en: How The War Was Waged Against The Ammonites And Happily Concluded.

items.text: How David Fell In Love With Bathsheba, And Slew Her Husband Uriah, For Which He Is Reproved By Nathan.
items.text_de: Wie David sich in Batseba verliebte und ihren Mann Uria tötete, wofür er von Nathan zurechtgewiesen wird.
items.text_en: How David Fell In Love With Bathsheba, And Slew Her Husband Uriah, For Which He Is Reproved By Nathan.

items.text: How Absalom Murdered Amnon, Who Had Forced His Own Sister; And How He Was Banished And Afterwards Recalled By David.
items.text_de: Wie Absalom Amnon ermordete, der seiner eigenen Schwester Gewalt angetan hatte; und wie er von David verbannt und später zurückgerufen wurde.
items.text_en: How Absalom Murdered Amnon, Who Had Forced His Own Sister; And How He Was Banished And Afterwards Recalled By David.

items.text: Concerning The Insurrection Of Absalom Against David And Concerning Ahithophel And Hushai; And Concerning Ziba And Shimei; And How Ahithophel Hanged Himself.
items.text_de: Über den Aufstand Absaloms gegen David und über Ahitofel und Huschai; und über Ziba und Schimi; und wie Ahitofel sich erhängte.
items.text_en: Concerning The Insurrection Of Absalom Against David And Concerning Ahithophel And Hushai; And Concerning Ziba And Shimei; And How Ahithophel Hanged Himself.

items.text: How, When Absalom Was Beaten, He Was Caught In A Tree By His Hair And Was Slain
items.text_de: Wie Absalom nach seiner Niederlage mit seinem Haar in einem Baum hängen blieb und getötet wurde
items.text_en: How, When Absalom Was Beaten, He Was Caught In A Tree By His Hair And Was Slain

items.text: How David, When He Had Recovered His Kingdom, Was Reconciled To Shimei, And To Ziba; And Showed A Great Affection To Barzillai; And How, Upon The Rise Of A Sedition, He Made Amasa Captain Of His Host, In Order To Pursue Seba; Which Amasa Was Slain By Joab.
items.text_de: Wie David, nachdem er sein Königreich wiedererlangt hatte, sich mit Schimi und mit Ziba versöhnte und Barsillai große Zuneigung erwies; und wie er, als ein Aufruhr ausbrach, Amasa zum Befehlshaber seines Heeres machte, um Scheba zu verfolgen; welcher Amasa von Joab getötet wurde.
items.text_en: How David, When He Had Recovered His Kingdom, Was Reconciled To Shimei, And To Ziba; And Showed A Great Affection To Barzillai; And How, Upon The Rise Of A Sedition, He Made Amasa Captain Of His Host, In Order To Pursue Seba; Which Amasa Was Slain By Joab.

items.text: How The Hebrews Were Delivered From A Famine When The Gibeonites Had Caused Punishment To Be Inflicted For Those Of Them That Had Been Slain: As Also, What Great Actions Were Performed Against The Philistines By David, And The Men Of Valor About Him.
items.text_de: Wie die Hebräer von einer Hungersnot befreit wurden, nachdem die Gibeoniter für diejenigen von ihnen, die getötet worden waren, Bestrafung hatten vollziehen lassen; und auch, welch große Taten David und die tapferen Männer um ihn gegen die Philister vollbrachten.
items.text_en: How The Hebrews Were Delivered From A Famine When The Gibeonites Had Caused Punishment To Be Inflicted For Those Of Them That Had Been Slain: As Also, What Great Actions Were Performed Against The Philistines By David, And The Men Of Valor About Him.

items.text: That When David Had Numbered the People, They Were Punished; and How the Divine Compassion Restrained That Punishment.
items.text_de: Dass das Volk bestraft wurde, als David es gezählt hatte; und wie das göttliche Erbarmen dieser Strafe Einhalt gebot.
items.text_en: That When David Had Numbered the People, They Were Punished; and How the Divine Compassion Restrained That Punishment.

items.text: That David Made Great Preparations For The House Of God; And That, Upon Adonijah's Attempt To Gain The Kingdom, He Appointed Solomon To Reign.
items.text_de: Dass David große Vorbereitungen für das Haus Gottes traf; und dass er, als Adonija versuchte, das Königtum an sich zu bringen, Salomo zum König bestimmte.
items.text_en: That David Made Great Preparations For The House Of God; And That, Upon Adonijah's Attempt To Gain The Kingdom, He Appointed Solomon To Reign.

items.text: What Charge David Gave To his Son Solomon At The Approach Of His Death, And How Many Things He Left Him For The Building Of The Temple.
items.text_de: Welchen Auftrag David seinem Sohn Salomo gab, als sein Tod nahte, und wie viele Dinge er ihm für den Bau des Tempels hinterließ.
items.text_en: What Charge David Gave To his Son Solomon At The Approach Of His Death, And How Many Things He Left Him For The Building Of The Temple.

items.text: How Solomon, When He Had Received The Kingdom Took Off His Enemies.
items.text_de: Wie Salomo, nachdem er das Königreich erhalten hatte, seine Feinde beseitigte.
items.text_en: How Solomon, When He Had Received The Kingdom Took Off His Enemies.

items.text: Concerning The Wife Of Solomon; Concerning His Wisdom And Riches; And Concerning What He Obtained Of Hiram For The Building Of The Temple.
items.text_de: Über die Frau Salomos; über seine Weisheit und seinen Reichtum; und über das, was er von Hiram für den Bau des Tempels erhielt.
items.text_en: Concerning The Wife Of Solomon; Concerning His Wisdom And Riches; And Concerning What He Obtained Of Hiram For The Building Of The Temple.

items.text: Of The Building Of This Temple
items.text_de: Vom Bau dieses Tempels
items.text_en: Of The Building Of This Temple

items.text: How Solomon Removed The Ark Into The Temple How He Made Supplication To God, And Offered Public Sacrifices To Him.
items.text_de: Wie Salomo die Lade in den Tempel überführte, wie er zu Gott flehte und ihm öffentliche Opfer darbrachte.
items.text_en: How Solomon Removed The Ark Into The Temple How He Made Supplication To God, And Offered Public Sacrifices To Him.

items.text: How Solomon Built Himself A Royal Palace, Very Costly And Splendid; And How He Solved The Riddles Which Were Sent Him By Hiram.
items.text_de: Wie Salomo sich einen sehr kostbaren und prächtigen Königspalast baute; und wie er die Rätsel löste, die Hiram ihm sandte.
items.text_en: How Solomon Built Himself A Royal Palace, Very Costly And Splendid; And How He Solved The Riddles Which Were Sent Him By Hiram.

items.text: How Solomon Fortified The City Of Jerusalem, And Built Great Cities; And How He Brought Some Of The Canaanites Into Subjection, And Entertained The Queen Of Egypt And Of Ethiopia.
items.text_de: Wie Salomo die Stadt Jerusalem befestigte und große Städte baute; und wie er einige der Kanaaniter unterwarf und die Königin von Ägypten und Äthiopien bewirtete.
items.text_en: How Solomon Fortified The City Of Jerusalem, And Built Great Cities; And How He Brought Some Of The Canaanites Into Subjection, And Entertained The Queen Of Egypt And Of Ethiopia.

items.text: How Solomon Grew Rich, And Fell Desperately In Love With Women And How God, Being Incensed At It, Raised Up Ader And Jeroboam Against Him. Concerning The Death Of Solomon.
items.text_de: Wie Salomo reich wurde und sich maßlos in Frauen verliebte und wie Gott, darüber erzürnt, Hadad und Jerobeam gegen ihn aufstehen ließ. Über den Tod Salomos.
items.text_en: How Solomon Grew Rich, And Fell Desperately In Love With Women And How God, Being Incensed At It, Raised Up Ader And Jeroboam Against Him. Concerning The Death Of Solomon.

items.text: How, Upon The Death Of Solomon The People Forsook His Son Rehoboam, And Ordained Jeroboam King Over The Ten Tribes.
items.text_de: Wie nach dem Tod Salomos das Volk seinen Sohn Rehabeam verließ und Jerobeam zum König über die zehn Stämme einsetzte.
items.text_en: How, Upon The Death Of Solomon The People Forsook His Son Rehoboam, And Ordained Jeroboam King Over The Ten Tribes.

items.text: How Jadon The Prophet Was Persuaded By Another Lying Prophet And Returned [To Bethel,] And Was Afterwards Slain By A Lion. As Also What Words The Wicked Prophet Made Use Of To Persuade The King, And Thereby Alienated His Mind From God.
items.text_de: Wie der Prophet Jadon von einem anderen, lügnerischen Propheten überredet wurde und [nach Bethel] zurückkehrte und danach von einem Löwen getötet wurde. Und auch, welcher Worte sich der gottlose Prophet bediente, um den König zu überreden, und wie er dadurch dessen Sinn von Gott abwandte.
items.text_en: How Jadon The Prophet Was Persuaded By Another Lying Prophet And Returned [To Bethel,] And Was Afterwards Slain By A Lion. As Also What Words The Wicked Prophet Made Use Of To Persuade The King, And Thereby Alienated His Mind From God.

items.text: Concerning Rehoboam, And How God Inflicted Punishment Upon Him For His Impiety By Shishak [King Of Egypt].
items.text_de: Über Rehabeam und wie Gott ihn für seine Gottlosigkeit durch Schischak [den König von Ägypten] bestrafte.
items.text_en: Concerning Rehoboam, And How God Inflicted Punishment Upon Him For His Impiety By Shishak [King Of Egypt].

items.text: Concerning The Death Of A Son Of Jeroboam. How Jeroboam Was Beaten By Abijah Who Died A Little Afterward And Was Succeeded In His Kingdom By Asa. And Also How, After The Death Of Jeroboam Baasha Destroyed His Son Nadab And All The House Of Jeroboam.
items.text_de: Über den Tod eines Sohnes Jerobeams. Wie Jerobeam von Abija besiegt wurde, der wenig später starb und dem Asa in seinem Königreich nachfolgte. Und auch, wie nach dem Tod Jerobeams Bascha dessen Sohn Nadab und das ganze Haus Jerobeams vernichtete.
items.text_en: Concerning The Death Of A Son Of Jeroboam. How Jeroboam Was Beaten By Abijah Who Died A Little Afterward And Was Succeeded In His Kingdom By Asa. And Also How, After The Death Of Jeroboam Baasha Destroyed His Son Nadab And All The House Of Jeroboam.

items.text: How Zerah, King Of The Ethiopians, Was Beaten By Asa; And How Asa, Upon Baasha's Making War Against Him, Invited The King Of The Damascens To Assist Him; And How, On The Destruction Of The House Of Baasha Zimri Got The Kingdom As Did His Son Ahab After Him.
items.text_de: Wie Serach, der König der Äthiopier, von Asa besiegt wurde; und wie Asa, als Bascha gegen ihn Krieg führte, den König der Damaskener zu Hilfe rief; und wie nach der Vernichtung des Hauses Bascha Simri das Königreich erlangte, wie nach ihm sein Sohn Ahab.
items.text_en: How Zerah, King Of The Ethiopians, Was Beaten By Asa; And How Asa, Upon Baasha's Making War Against Him, Invited The King Of The Damascens To Assist Him; And How, On The Destruction Of The House Of Baasha Zimri Got The Kingdom As Did His Son Ahab After Him.

items.text: How Ahab WHen He Had Taken Jezebel To Wife Became More Wicked Than All The Kings That Had Been Before Him; Of The Actions Of The Prophet Elijah, And What Befell Naboth.
items.text_de: Wie Ahab, nachdem er Isebel zur Frau genommen hatte, gottloser wurde als alle Könige vor ihm; von den Taten des Propheten Elia und was Nabot widerfuhr.
items.text_en: How Ahab WHen He Had Taken Jezebel To Wife Became More Wicked Than All The Kings That Had Been Before Him; Of The Actions Of The Prophet Elijah, And What Befell Naboth.

items.text: How Hadad King Of Damascus And Of Syria, Made Two Expeditions Against Ahab And Was Beaten.
items.text_de: Wie Hadad, der König von Damaskus und Syrien, zwei Feldzüge gegen Ahab unternahm und besiegt wurde.
items.text_en: How Hadad King Of Damascus And Of Syria, Made Two Expeditions Against Ahab And Was Beaten.

items.text: Concerning Jehoshaphat The King Of Jerusalem And How Ahab Made An Expedition Against The Syrians And Was Assisted Therein By Jehoshaphat, But Was Himself Overcome In Battle And Perished Therein.
items.text_de: Über Joschafat, den König von Jerusalem, und wie Ahab einen Feldzug gegen die Syrer unternahm und dabei von Joschafat unterstützt wurde, selbst aber in der Schlacht unterlag und darin umkam.
items.text_en: Concerning Jehoshaphat The King Of Jerusalem And How Ahab Made An Expedition Against The Syrians And Was Assisted Therein By Jehoshaphat, But Was Himself Overcome In Battle And Perished Therein.

items.text: Concerning Jehoshaphat Again; How He Constituted Judges And, By God's Assistance Overcame His Enemies.
items.text_de: Wiederum über Joschafat; wie er Richter einsetzte und mit Gottes Hilfe seine Feinde besiegte.
items.text_en: Concerning Jehoshaphat Again; How He Constituted Judges And, By God's Assistance Overcame His Enemies.

items.text: Concerning Ahaziah; The King Of Israel; And Again Concerning The Prophet Elijah.
items.text_de: Über Ahasja, den König von Israel; und wiederum über den Propheten Elia.
items.text_en: Concerning Ahaziah; The King Of Israel; And Again Concerning The Prophet Elijah.

items.text: How Joram And Jehoshaphat Made An Expedition Against The Moabites; As Also Concerning The Wonders Of Elisha; And The Death Of Jehoshaphat.
items.text_de: Wie Joram und Joschafat einen Feldzug gegen die Moabiter unternahmen; und auch über die Wunder Elisas; und den Tod Joschafats.
items.text_en: How Joram And Jehoshaphat Made An Expedition Against The Moabites; As Also Concerning The Wonders Of Elisha; And The Death Of Jehoshaphat.

items.text: Jehoram Succeeds Jehoshaphat; How Joram, His Namesake, King Of Israel, Fought With The Syrians; And What Wonders Were Done By The Prophet Elisha.
items.text_de: Joram folgt Joschafat nach; wie Joram, sein Namensvetter, der König von Israel, mit den Syrern kämpfte; und welche Wunder der Prophet Elisa wirkte.
items.text_en: Jehoram Succeeds Jehoshaphat; How Joram, His Namesake, King Of Israel, Fought With The Syrians; And What Wonders Were Done By The Prophet Elisha.

items.text: Concerning The Wickedness Of Jehoram King O Jerusalem; His Defeat And Death.
items.text_de: Über die Gottlosigkeit Jorams, des Königs von Jerusalem; seine Niederlage und sein Tod.
items.text_en: Concerning The Wickedness Of Jehoram King O Jerusalem; His Defeat And Death.

items.text: How Jehu Was Anointed King, And Slew Both Joram And Ahaziah; As Also What He Did For The Punishment Of The Wicked.
items.text_de: Wie Jehu zum König gesalbt wurde und sowohl Joram als auch Ahasja tötete; und auch, was er zur Bestrafung der Gottlosen tat.
items.text_en: How Jehu Was Anointed King, And Slew Both Joram And Ahaziah; As Also What He Did For The Punishment Of The Wicked.

items.text: How Athaliah Reigned Over Jerusalem For Five [Six] Years When Jehoiada The High Priest Slew Her And Made Jehoash, The Son Of Ahaziah, King.
items.text_de: Wie Atalja fünf [sechs] Jahre über Jerusalem herrschte, bis der Hohepriester Jojada sie tötete und Joasch, den Sohn Ahasjas, zum König machte.
items.text_en: How Athaliah Reigned Over Jerusalem For Five [Six] Years When Jehoiada The High Priest Slew Her And Made Jehoash, The Son Of Ahaziah, King.

items.text: Hazael Makes An Expedition Against The People Of Israel And The Inhabitants Of Jerusalem. Jehu Dies, And Jehoahaz Succeeds In The Government. Jehoash The King Of Jerusalem At First Is Careful About The Worship Of God But Afterwards Becomes Impious And Commands Zechariah To Be Stoned. When Jehoash [King Of Judah] Was Dead, Amaziah Succeeds Him In The Kingdom.
items.text_de: Hasaël unternimmt einen Feldzug gegen das Volk Israel und die Bewohner Jerusalems. Jehu stirbt, und Joahas folgt ihm in der Regierung nach. Joasch, der König von Jerusalem, ist anfangs um den Gottesdienst bemüht, wird aber später gottlos und befiehlt, Sacharja zu steinigen. Als Joasch [der König von Juda] tot war, folgt ihm Amazja im Königreich nach.
items.text_en: Hazael Makes An Expedition Against The People Of Israel And The Inhabitants Of Jerusalem. Jehu Dies, And Jehoahaz Succeeds In The Government. Jehoash The King Of Jerusalem At First Is Careful About The Worship Of God But Afterwards Becomes Impious And Commands Zechariah To Be Stoned. When Jehoash [King Of Judah] Was Dead, Amaziah Succeeds Him In The Kingdom.

items.text: How Amaziah Made An Expedition Against The Edomites And Amalekites And Conquered Them; But When He Afterwards Made War Against Joash, He Was Beaten And Not Long After Was Slain, And Uzziah Succeeded In The Government.
items.text_de: Wie Amazja einen Feldzug gegen die Edomiter und Amalekiter unternahm und sie besiegte; als er aber später gegen Joasch Krieg führte, wurde er geschlagen und nicht lange danach getötet, und Usija folgte ihm in der Regierung nach.
items.text_en: How Amaziah Made An Expedition Against The Edomites And Amalekites And Conquered Them; But When He Afterwards Made War Against Joash, He Was Beaten And Not Long After Was Slain, And Uzziah Succeeded In The Government.

items.text: Concerning Jeroboam King Of Israel And Jonah The Prophet; And How After The Death Of Jeroboam His Son Zachariah Took The Government. How Uzziah, King Of Jerusalem, Subdued The Nations That Were Round About Him; And What Befell Him When He Attempted To Offer Incense To God.
items.text_de: Über Jerobeam, den König von Israel, und den Propheten Jona; und wie nach dem Tod Jerobeams sein Sohn Secharja die Regierung übernahm. Wie Usija, der König von Jerusalem, die Völker ringsum unterwarf; und was ihm widerfuhr, als er Gott Räucherwerk darbringen wollte.
items.text_en: Concerning Jeroboam King Of Israel And Jonah The Prophet; And How After The Death Of Jeroboam His Son Zachariah Took The Government. How Uzziah, King Of Jerusalem, Subdued The Nations That Were Round About Him; And What Befell Him When He Attempted To Offer Incense To God.

items.text: How Zachariah Shallum, Menahem Pekahiah And Pekah Took The Government Over The Israelites ; And How Pul And Tiglath-Pileser Made An Expedition Against The Israelites. How Jotham, The Son Of Uzziah Reigned Over The Tribe Of Judah; And What Things Nahum Prophesied Against The Assyrians.
items.text_de: Wie Secharja, Schallum, Menahem, Pekachja und Pekach die Regierung über die Israeliten übernahmen; und wie Pul und Tiglat-Pileser einen Feldzug gegen die Israeliten unternahmen. Wie Jotam, der Sohn Usijas, über den Stamm Juda herrschte; und was Nahum gegen die Assyrer weissagte.
items.text_en: How Zachariah Shallum, Menahem Pekahiah And Pekah Took The Government Over The Israelites ; And How Pul And Tiglath-Pileser Made An Expedition Against The Israelites. How Jotham, The Son Of Uzziah Reigned Over The Tribe Of Judah; And What Things Nahum Prophesied Against The Assyrians.

items.text: How Upon The Death Of Jotham, Ahaz Reigned In His Stead; Against Whom Rezin, King Of Syria And Pekah King Of Israel, Made War; And How Tiglath-Pileser, King Of Assyria Came To The Assistance Of Ahaz, And Laid Syria Waste And Removing The Damascenes Into Media Placed Other Nations In Their Room.
items.text_de: Wie nach dem Tod Jotams Ahas an seiner Stelle herrschte; gegen den Rezin, der König von Syrien, und Pekach, der König von Israel, Krieg führten; und wie Tiglat-Pileser, der König von Assyrien, Ahas zu Hilfe kam, Syrien verwüstete, die Damaskener nach Medien umsiedelte und andere Völker an ihre Stelle setzte.
items.text_en: How Upon The Death Of Jotham, Ahaz Reigned In His Stead; Against Whom Rezin, King Of Syria And Pekah King Of Israel, Made War; And How Tiglath-Pileser, King Of Assyria Came To The Assistance Of Ahaz, And Laid Syria Waste And Removing The Damascenes Into Media Placed Other Nations In Their Room.

items.text: How Pekah Died By The Treachery Of Hoshea Who Was A Little After Subdued By Shalmaneser; And How Hezekiah Reigned Instead Of Ahaz; And What Actions Of Piety And Justice He Did.
items.text_de: Wie Pekach durch den Verrat Hoscheas umkam, der wenig später von Salmanassar unterworfen wurde; und wie Hiskia an Stelle des Ahas herrschte; und welche Taten der Frömmigkeit und Gerechtigkeit er vollbrachte.
items.text_en: How Pekah Died By The Treachery Of Hoshea Who Was A Little After Subdued By Shalmaneser; And How Hezekiah Reigned Instead Of Ahaz; And What Actions Of Piety And Justice He Did.

items.text: How Shalmaneser Took Samaria By Force And How He Transplanted The Ten Tribes Into Media, And Brought The Nation Of The Cutheans Into Their Country [In Their Room].
items.text_de: Wie Salmanassar Samaria mit Gewalt einnahm und wie er die zehn Stämme nach Medien verpflanzte und das Volk der Kutäer in ihr Land [an ihre Stelle] brachte.
items.text_en: How Shalmaneser Took Samaria By Force And How He Transplanted The Ten Tribes Into Media, And Brought The Nation Of The Cutheans Into Their Country [In Their Room].

items.text: How Sennacherib Made An Expedition Against Hezekiah; What Threatenings Rabshakeh Made To Hezekiah When Sennacherib Was Gone Against The Egyptians; How Isaiah The Prophet Encouraged Him; How Sennacherib Having Failed Of Success In Egypt, Returned Thence To Jerusalem; And How Upon His Finding His Army Destroyed, He Returned Home; And What Befell Him A Little Afterward.
items.text_de: Wie Sanherib einen Feldzug gegen Hiskia unternahm; welche Drohungen Rabschake gegen Hiskia ausstieß, als Sanherib gegen die Ägypter gezogen war; wie der Prophet Jesaja ihn ermutigte; wie Sanherib, nachdem er in Ägypten keinen Erfolg gehabt hatte, von dort nach Jerusalem zurückkehrte; und wie er, als er sein Heer vernichtet fand, heimkehrte; und was ihm wenig später widerfuhr.
items.text_en: How Sennacherib Made An Expedition Against Hezekiah; What Threatenings Rabshakeh Made To Hezekiah When Sennacherib Was Gone Against The Egyptians; How Isaiah The Prophet Encouraged Him; How Sennacherib Having Failed Of Success In Egypt, Returned Thence To Jerusalem; And How Upon His Finding His Army Destroyed, He Returned Home; And What Befell Him A Little Afterward.

items.text: How Hezekiah Was Sick, And Ready To Die; And How God Bestowed Upon Him Fifteen Years Longer Life, [And Secured That Promise] By The Going Back Of The Shadow Ten Degrees.
items.text_de: Wie Hiskia krank und dem Tode nahe war; und wie Gott ihm fünfzehn weitere Lebensjahre schenkte [und diese Verheißung bekräftigte], indem der Schatten zehn Stufen zurückging.
items.text_en: How Hezekiah Was Sick, And Ready To Die; And How God Bestowed Upon Him Fifteen Years Longer Life, [And Secured That Promise] By The Going Back Of The Shadow Ten Degrees.

items.text: How Manasseh Reigned After Hezekiah; And How When He Was In Captivity He Returned To God And Was Restored To His Kingdom And Left It To [His Son] Amon.
items.text_de: Wie Manasse nach Hiskia herrschte; und wie er, als er in Gefangenschaft war, zu Gott umkehrte, in sein Königreich wieder eingesetzt wurde und es [seinem Sohn] Amon hinterließ.
items.text_en: How Manasseh Reigned After Hezekiah; And How When He Was In Captivity He Returned To God And Was Restored To His Kingdom And Left It To [His Son] Amon.

items.text: How Amon Reigned Instead Of Manasseh; And After Amon Reigned Josiah; He Was Both Righteous And Religious. As Also Concerning Huldah The Prophetess.
items.text_de: Wie Amon an Stelle Manasses herrschte; und nach Amon herrschte Josia; er war sowohl gerecht als auch gottesfürchtig. Und auch über die Prophetin Hulda.
items.text_en: How Amon Reigned Instead Of Manasseh; And After Amon Reigned Josiah; He Was Both Righteous And Religious. As Also Concerning Huldah The Prophetess.

items.text: How Josiah Fought With Neco [King Of Egypt.] And Was Wounded And Died In A Little Time Afterward; As Also How Neco Carried Jehoahaz, Who Had Been Made King Into Egypt And Delivered The Kingdom To Jehoiakim; And [Lastly] Concerning Jeremiah And Ezekiel.
items.text_de: Wie Josia mit Necho [dem König von Ägypten] kämpfte, verwundet wurde und kurze Zeit danach starb; und auch, wie Necho Joahas, der zum König gemacht worden war, nach Ägypten wegführte und das Königreich Jojakim übergab; und [schließlich] über Jeremia und Hesekiel.
items.text_en: How Josiah Fought With Neco [King Of Egypt.] And Was Wounded And Died In A Little Time Afterward; As Also How Neco Carried Jehoahaz, Who Had Been Made King Into Egypt And Delivered The Kingdom To Jehoiakim; And [Lastly] Concerning Jeremiah And Ezekiel.

items.text: How Nebuchadnezzar, When He Had Conquered The King Of Egypt Made An Expedition Against The Jews, And Slew Jehoiakim, And Made Jeholachin His Son King.
items.text_de: Wie Nebukadnezar, nachdem er den König von Ägypten besiegt hatte, einen Feldzug gegen die Juden unternahm, Jojakim tötete und dessen Sohn Jojachin zum König machte.
items.text_en: How Nebuchadnezzar, When He Had Conquered The King Of Egypt Made An Expedition Against The Jews, And Slew Jehoiakim, And Made Jeholachin His Son King.

items.text: That The King Of Babylon Repented Of Making Jehoiachin King, And Took Him Away To Babylon And Delivered The Kingdom To Zedekiah. This King Would Not Relieve What Was Predicted By Jeremiah And Ezekiel But Joined Himself To The Egyptians; Who When They Came Into Judea, Were Vanquished By The King Of Babylon; As Also What Befell Jeremiah.
items.text_de: Dass der König von Babylon es bereute, Jojachin zum König gemacht zu haben, ihn nach Babylon wegführte und das Königreich Zedekia übergab. Dieser König wollte nicht glauben, was Jeremia und Hesekiel vorhergesagt hatten, sondern verbündete sich mit den Ägyptern, die, als sie nach Judäa kamen, vom König von Babylon besiegt wurden; und auch, was Jeremia widerfuhr.
items.text_en: That The King Of Babylon Repented Of Making Jehoiachin King, And Took Him Away To Babylon And Delivered The Kingdom To Zedekiah. This King Would Not Relieve What Was Predicted By Jeremiah And Ezekiel But Joined Himself To The Egyptians; Who When They Came Into Judea, Were Vanquished By The King Of Babylon; As Also What Befell Jeremiah.

items.text: How The King Of Babylon Took Jerusalem And Burnt The Temple And Removed The People Of Jerusalem And Zedekiah To Babylon. As Also, Who They Were That Had Succeeded In The High Priesthood Under The Kings.
items.text_de: Wie der König von Babylon Jerusalem einnahm, den Tempel verbrannte und das Volk von Jerusalem und Zedekia nach Babylon wegführte. Und auch, wer diejenigen waren, die unter den Königen im Hohepriesteramt aufeinander folgten.
items.text_en: How The King Of Babylon Took Jerusalem And Burnt The Temple And Removed The People Of Jerusalem And Zedekiah To Babylon. As Also, Who They Were That Had Succeeded In The High Priesthood Under The Kings.

items.text: How Nebuzaradan Set Gedaliah Over The Jews That Were Left In Judea Which Gedaliah Was A Little Afterward Slain By Ishmael; And How Johanan After Ishmael Was Driven Away Went Down Into Egypt With The People Which People Nebuchadnezzar When He Made An Expedition Against The Egyptians Took Captive And Brought Them Away To Babylon.
items.text_de: Wie Nebusaradan Gedalja über die Juden setzte, die in Judäa zurückgeblieben waren, welcher Gedalja wenig später von Jischmael getötet wurde; und wie Johanan, nachdem Jischmael vertrieben worden war, mit dem Volk nach Ägypten hinabzog, welches Volk Nebukadnezar, als er einen Feldzug gegen die Ägypter unternahm, gefangen nahm und nach Babylon wegführte.
items.text_en: How Nebuzaradan Set Gedaliah Over The Jews That Were Left In Judea Which Gedaliah Was A Little Afterward Slain By Ishmael; And How Johanan After Ishmael Was Driven Away Went Down Into Egypt With The People Which People Nebuchadnezzar When He Made An Expedition Against The Egyptians Took Captive And Brought Them Away To Babylon.

items.text: Concerning Daniel And What Befell Him At Babylon.
items.text_de: Über Daniel und was ihm in Babylon widerfuhr.
items.text_en: Concerning Daniel And What Befell Him At Babylon.

items.text: Concerning Nebuchadnezzar And His Successors And How Their Government Was Dissolved By The Persians; And What Things Befell DanieL In Media; And What Prophecies He Delivered There.
items.text_de: Über Nebukadnezar und seine Nachfolger und wie ihre Herrschaft von den Persern aufgelöst wurde; und was Daniel in Medien widerfuhr; und welche Weissagungen er dort verkündete.
items.text_en: Concerning Nebuchadnezzar And His Successors And How Their Government Was Dissolved By The Persians; And What Things Befell DanieL In Media; And What Prophecies He Delivered There.

items.text: How Cyrus, King Of The Persians, Delivered The Jews Out Of Babylon And Suffered Them To Return To Their Own Country And To Build Their Temple, For Which Work He Gave Them Money.
items.text_de: Wie Kyros, der König der Perser, die Juden aus Babylon befreite und ihnen erlaubte, in ihr eigenes Land zurückzukehren und ihren Tempel zu bauen, wofür er ihnen Geld gab.
items.text_en: How Cyrus, King Of The Persians, Delivered The Jews Out Of Babylon And Suffered Them To Return To Their Own Country And To Build Their Temple, For Which Work He Gave Them Money.

items.text: How Upon The Death Of Cyrus The Jews Were Hindered In Building Of The Temple By The Cutheans, And The Neighboring Governors; And How Cambyses Entirely Forbade The Jews To Do Any Such Thing.
items.text_de: Wie nach dem Tod des Kyros die Juden von den Kutäern und den benachbarten Statthaltern am Bau des Tempels gehindert wurden; und wie Kambyses den Juden gänzlich verbot, etwas Derartiges zu tun.
items.text_en: How Upon The Death Of Cyrus The Jews Were Hindered In Building Of The Temple By The Cutheans, And The Neighboring Governors; And How Cambyses Entirely Forbade The Jews To Do Any Such Thing.

items.text: How After The Death Of Cambyses And The Slaughter Of The Magi But Under The Reign Of Darius, Zorobabel Was Superior To The Rest In The Solution Of Problems And Thereby Obtained This Favor Of The King, That The Temple Should Be Built.
items.text_de: Wie nach dem Tod des Kambyses und der Ermordung der Magier, unter der Herrschaft des Dareios, Serubbabel die Übrigen im Lösen von Rätselfragen übertraf und dadurch vom König die Gunst erlangte, dass der Tempel gebaut werden sollte.
items.text_en: How After The Death Of Cambyses And The Slaughter Of The Magi But Under The Reign Of Darius, Zorobabel Was Superior To The Rest In The Solution Of Problems And Thereby Obtained This Favor Of The King, That The Temple Should Be Built.

items.text: How The Temple Was Built While The Cutheans Endeavored In Vain To Obstruct The Work.
items.text_de: Wie der Tempel gebaut wurde, während die Kutäer vergeblich versuchten, das Werk zu behindern.
items.text_en: How The Temple Was Built While The Cutheans Endeavored In Vain To Obstruct The Work.

items.text: How Xerxes The Son Of Darius Was Well Disposed To The Jews; As Also Concerning Esdras And Nehemiah.
items.text_de: Wie Xerxes, der Sohn des Dareios, den Juden wohlgesinnt war; und auch über Esra und Nehemia.
items.text_en: How Xerxes The Son Of Darius Was Well Disposed To The Jews; As Also Concerning Esdras And Nehemiah.

items.text: Concerning Esther And Mordecai And Haman; And How In The Reign Of Artaxerxes The Whole Nation Of The Jews Was In Danger Of Perishing.
items.text_de: Über Ester, Mordechai und Haman; und wie unter der Herrschaft des Artaxerxes das ganze Volk der Juden in Gefahr war umzukommen.
items.text_en: Concerning Esther And Mordecai And Haman; And How In The Reign Of Artaxerxes The Whole Nation Of The Jews Was In Danger Of Perishing.

items.text: How John Slew His Brother Jesus In The Temple; And How Bagoses Offered Many Injuries To The Jews; And What Sanballat Did.
items.text_de: Wie Johannes seinen Bruder Jesus im Tempel tötete; und wie Bagoses den Juden viel Unrecht zufügte; und was Sanballat tat.
items.text_en: How John Slew His Brother Jesus In The Temple; And How Bagoses Offered Many Injuries To The Jews; And What Sanballat Did.

items.text: Concerning Sanballat And Manasseh, And The Temple Which They Built On Mount Gerizzim; As Also How Alexander Made His Entry Into The City Jerusalem, And What Benefits He Bestowed On The Jews.
items.text_de: Über Sanballat und Manasse und den Tempel, den sie auf dem Berg Garizim bauten; und auch, wie Alexander in die Stadt Jerusalem einzog und welche Wohltaten er den Juden erwies.
items.text_en: Concerning Sanballat And Manasseh, And The Temple Which They Built On Mount Gerizzim; As Also How Alexander Made His Entry Into The City Jerusalem, And What Benefits He Bestowed On The Jews.

items.text: How Ptolemy The Son Of Lagus Took Jerusalem And Judea By Deceit And Treachery, And Carried Many Thence, And Planted Them In Egypt.
items.text_de: Wie Ptolemaios, der Sohn des Lagos, Jerusalem und Judäa durch List und Verrat einnahm, viele von dort wegführte und sie in Ägypten ansiedelte.
items.text_en: How Ptolemy The Son Of Lagus Took Jerusalem And Judea By Deceit And Treachery, And Carried Many Thence, And Planted Them In Egypt.

items.text: How Ptolemy Philadelphus Procured The Laws Of The Jews To Be Translated Into The Greek Tongue And Set Many Captives Free, And Dedicated Many Gifts To God.
items.text_de: Wie Ptolemaios Philadelphos die Gesetze der Juden ins Griechische übersetzen ließ, viele Gefangene freiließ und Gott viele Weihgeschenke darbrachte.
items.text_en: How Ptolemy Philadelphus Procured The Laws Of The Jews To Be Translated Into The Greek Tongue And Set Many Captives Free, And Dedicated Many Gifts To God.

items.text: How The Kings Of Asia Honored The Nation Of The Jews And Made Them Citizens Of Those Cities Which They Built.
items.text_de: Wie die Könige Asiens das Volk der Juden ehrten und sie zu Bürgern der Städte machten, die sie gründeten.
items.text_en: How The Kings Of Asia Honored The Nation Of The Jews And Made Them Citizens Of Those Cities Which They Built.

items.text: How Antiochus Made A League With Ptolemy And How Onias Provoked Ptolemy Euergetes To Anger; And How Joseph Brought All Things Right Again, And Entered Into Friendship With Him; And What Other Things Were Done By Joseph, And His Son Hyrcanus.
items.text_de: Wie Antiochos mit Ptolemaios ein Bündnis schloss und wie Onias Ptolemaios Euergetes zum Zorn reizte; und wie Joseph alles wieder in Ordnung brachte und Freundschaft mit ihm schloss; und was Joseph und sein Sohn Hyrkanos sonst noch taten.
items.text_en: How Antiochus Made A League With Ptolemy And How Onias Provoked Ptolemy Euergetes To Anger; And How Joseph Brought All Things Right Again, And Entered Into Friendship With Him; And What Other Things Were Done By Joseph, And His Son Hyrcanus.

items.text: How, Upon The Quarrels One Against Another About The High Priesthood Antiochus Made An Expedition Against Jerusalem, Took The City And Pillaged The Temples. And Distressed The Jews' As Also How Many Of The Jews Forsook The Laws Of Their Country; And How The Samaritans Followed The Customs Of The Greeks And Named Their Temple At Mount Gerizzim The Temple Of Jupiter Hellenius.
items.text_de: Wie Antiochos anlässlich der Streitigkeiten untereinander um das Hohepriesteramt einen Feldzug gegen Jerusalem unternahm, die Stadt einnahm, die Tempel plünderte und die Juden bedrängte; und auch, wie viele der Juden die Gesetze ihres Landes verließen; und wie die Samaritaner die Sitten der Griechen annahmen und ihren Tempel auf dem Berg Garizim Tempel des Jupiter Hellenios nannten.
items.text_en: How, Upon The Quarrels One Against Another About The High Priesthood Antiochus Made An Expedition Against Jerusalem, Took The City And Pillaged The Temples. And Distressed The Jews' As Also How Many Of The Jews Forsook The Laws Of Their Country; And How The Samaritans Followed The Customs Of The Greeks And Named Their Temple At Mount Gerizzim The Temple Of Jupiter Hellenius.

items.text: How, Upon Antiochus's Prohibition To The Jews To Make Use Of The Laws Of Their Country Mattathias, The Son Of Asamoneus, Alone Despised The King, And Overcame The Generals Of Antiochus's Army; As Also Concerning The Death Of Mattathias, And The Succession Of Judas.
items.text_de: Wie nach dem Verbot des Antiochos, dass die Juden die Gesetze ihres Landes befolgten, Mattathias, der Sohn des Asamonaios, als Einziger den König missachtete und die Feldherren des Heeres des Antiochos besiegte; und auch über den Tod des Mattathias und die Nachfolge des Judas.
items.text_en: How, Upon Antiochus's Prohibition To The Jews To Make Use Of The Laws Of Their Country Mattathias, The Son Of Asamoneus, Alone Despised The King, And Overcame The Generals Of Antiochus's Army; As Also Concerning The Death Of Mattathias, And The Succession Of Judas.

items.text: How Judas Overthrew The Forces Of Apollonius And Seron And Killed The Generals Of Their Armies Themselves; And How When, A Little While Afterwards Lysias And Gorgias Were Beaten He Went Up To Jerusalem And Purified The Temple.
items.text_de: Wie Judas die Streitkräfte des Apollonios und des Seron schlug und die Feldherren ihrer Heere selbst tötete; und wie er, nachdem wenig später Lysias und Gorgias geschlagen worden waren, nach Jerusalem hinaufzog und den Tempel reinigte.
items.text_en: How Judas Overthrew The Forces Of Apollonius And Seron And Killed The Generals Of Their Armies Themselves; And How When, A Little While Afterwards Lysias And Gorgias Were Beaten He Went Up To Jerusalem And Purified The Temple.

items.text: How Judas Subdued The Nations Round About; And How Simon Beat The People Of Tyre And Ptolemais; And How Judas Overcame Timotheus, And Forced Him To Fly Away, And Did Many Other Things After Joseph And Azarias Had Been Beaten
items.text_de: Wie Judas die Völker ringsum unterwarf; und wie Simon die Bewohner von Tyros und Ptolemais schlug; und wie Judas Timotheos besiegte, ihn zur Flucht zwang und viele andere Dinge vollbrachte, nachdem Joseph und Azarias geschlagen worden waren
items.text_en: How Judas Subdued The Nations Round About; And How Simon Beat The People Of Tyre And Ptolemais; And How Judas Overcame Timotheus, And Forced Him To Fly Away, And Did Many Other Things After Joseph And Azarias Had Been Beaten

items.text: Concerning The Death Of Antiochus Epiphane. How Antiochus Eupator Fought Against Juda And Besieged Him In The Temple And Afterwards Made Peace With Him And Departed; Of Alcimus And Onias.
items.text_de: Über den Tod des Antiochos Epiphanes. Wie Antiochos Eupator gegen Judas kämpfte, ihn im Tempel belagerte, danach Frieden mit ihm schloss und abzog; von Alkimos und Onias.
items.text_en: Concerning The Death Of Antiochus Epiphane. How Antiochus Eupator Fought Against Juda And Besieged Him In The Temple And Afterwards Made Peace With Him And Departed; Of Alcimus And Onias.

items.text: How Bacchides, The General Of Demetrius's Army, Made An Expedition Against Judea, And Returned Without Success; And How Nicanor Was Sent A Little Afterward Against Judas And Perished, Together With His Army; As Also Concerning The Death Of Alcimus And The Succession Of Judas.
items.text_de: Wie Bakchides, der Feldherr des Heeres des Demetrios, einen Feldzug gegen Judäa unternahm und ohne Erfolg zurückkehrte; und wie Nikanor wenig später gegen Judas gesandt wurde und samt seinem Heer umkam; und auch über den Tod des Alkimos und die Nachfolge des Judas.
items.text_en: How Bacchides, The General Of Demetrius's Army, Made An Expedition Against Judea, And Returned Without Success; And How Nicanor Was Sent A Little Afterward Against Judas And Perished, Together With His Army; As Also Concerning The Death Of Alcimus And The Succession Of Judas.

items.text: That Bacchides Was Again Sent Out Against Judas; And How Judas Fell As He Was Courageously Fighting.
items.text_de: Dass Bakchides abermals gegen Judas ausgesandt wurde; und wie Judas fiel, während er tapfer kämpfte.
items.text_en: That Bacchides Was Again Sent Out Against Judas; And How Judas Fell As He Was Courageously Fighting.

items.text: How Jonathan Took The Government After His Brother Judas; And How He, Together With His Brother Simon, Waged War Against Bacchides.
items.text_de: Wie Jonathan nach seinem Bruder Judas die Herrschaft übernahm und wie er zusammen mit seinem Bruder Simon Krieg gegen Bakchides führte.
items.text_en: How Jonathan Took The Government After His Brother Judas; And How He, Together With His Brother Simon, Waged War Against Bacchides.

items.text: How Alexander [Bala] In His War With Demetrius, Granted Jonathan Many Advantages And Appointed Him To Be High Priest And Persuaded Him To Assist Him Although Demetrius Promised Him Greater Advantages On The Other Side. Concerning The Death Of Demetrius.
items.text_de: Wie Alexander [Balas] in seinem Krieg mit Demetrios Jonathan viele Vorteile gewährte, ihn zum Hohepriester ernannte und ihn dazu bewog, ihm beizustehen, obwohl Demetrios ihm auf der anderen Seite größere Vorteile versprach. Über den Tod des Demetrios.
items.text_en: How Alexander [Bala] In His War With Demetrius, Granted Jonathan Many Advantages And Appointed Him To Be High Priest And Persuaded Him To Assist Him Although Demetrius Promised Him Greater Advantages On The Other Side. Concerning The Death Of Demetrius.

items.text: The Friendship That Was Between Onias And Ptolemy Philometor; And How Onias Built A Temple In Egypt Like To That At Jerusalem.
items.text_de: Die Freundschaft zwischen Onias und Ptolemaios Philometor und wie Onias in Ägypten einen Tempel nach dem Vorbild des Tempels in Jerusalem baute.
items.text_en: The Friendship That Was Between Onias And Ptolemy Philometor; And How Onias Built A Temple In Egypt Like To That At Jerusalem.

items.text: How Alexander Honored Jonathan After An Extraordinary Manner; And How Demetrius, The Son Of Demetrius, Overcame Alexander And Made A League Of Friendship With Jonathan.
items.text_de: Wie Alexander Jonathan in außergewöhnlicher Weise ehrte und wie Demetrios, der Sohn des Demetrios, Alexander besiegte und mit Jonathan ein Freundschaftsbündnis schloss.
items.text_en: How Alexander Honored Jonathan After An Extraordinary Manner; And How Demetrius, The Son Of Demetrius, Overcame Alexander And Made A League Of Friendship With Jonathan.

items.text: How Trypho After He Had Beaten Demetrius Delivered The Kingdom To Antiochus The Son Of Alexander, And Gained Jonathan For His Assistant; And Concerning The Actions And Embassies Of Jonathan.
items.text_de: Wie Tryphon, nachdem er Demetrios geschlagen hatte, das Königreich an Antiochos, den Sohn Alexanders, übergab und Jonathan als Helfer gewann; und über die Taten und Gesandtschaften Jonathans.
items.text_en: How Trypho After He Had Beaten Demetrius Delivered The Kingdom To Antiochus The Son Of Alexander, And Gained Jonathan For His Assistant; And Concerning The Actions And Embassies Of Jonathan.

items.text: How Jonathan Was Slain By Treachery; And How Thereupon The Jews Made Simon Their General And High Priest: What Courageous Actions He Also Performed Especially Against Trypho.
items.text_de: Wie Jonathan durch Verrat getötet wurde und wie die Juden daraufhin Simon zu ihrem Feldherrn und Hohepriester machten; und welche mutigen Taten er vollbrachte, besonders gegen Tryphon.
items.text_en: How Jonathan Was Slain By Treachery; And How Thereupon The Jews Made Simon Their General And High Priest: What Courageous Actions He Also Performed Especially Against Trypho.

items.text: How Simon Confederated Himself With Antiochus Pius, And Made War Against Trypho, And A Little Afterward, Against Cendebeus, The General Of Antiochus's Army; As Also How Simon Was Murdered By His Son-In-Law Ptolemy, And That By Treachery.
items.text_de: Wie Simon sich mit Antiochos Pius verbündete und Krieg gegen Tryphon führte und wenig später gegen Kendebaios, den Feldherrn des Heeres des Antiochos; und wie Simon von seinem Schwiegersohn Ptolemaios ermordet wurde, und zwar durch Verrat.
items.text_en: How Simon Confederated Himself With Antiochus Pius, And Made War Against Trypho, And A Little Afterward, Against Cendebeus, The General Of Antiochus's Army; As Also How Simon Was Murdered By His Son-In-Law Ptolemy, And That By Treachery.

items.text: Hyrcanus Receives The High Priesthood, And Ejects Ptolemy Out Of The Country. Antiochus Makes War Against Hyrcanus And Afterwards Makes A League With Him.
items.text_de: Hyrkanos erhält das Hohepriesteramt und vertreibt Ptolemaios aus dem Land. Antiochos führt Krieg gegen Hyrkanos und schließt danach ein Bündnis mit ihm.
items.text_en: Hyrcanus Receives The High Priesthood, And Ejects Ptolemy Out Of The Country. Antiochus Makes War Against Hyrcanus And Afterwards Makes A League With Him.

items.text: How, After The Death Of Antiochus, Hyrcanus Made An Expedition Against Syria, And Made A League With The Romans. Concerning The Death Of King Demetrius And Alexander.
items.text_de: Wie Hyrkanos nach dem Tod des Antiochos einen Feldzug gegen Syrien unternahm und ein Bündnis mit den Römern schloss. Über den Tod König Demetrios' und Alexanders.
items.text_en: How, After The Death Of Antiochus, Hyrcanus Made An Expedition Against Syria, And Made A League With The Romans. Concerning The Death Of King Demetrius And Alexander.

items.text: How Upon The Quarrel Between Antiochus Grypus And Antiochus Cyzicenus About The Kingdom of samaria Hyrcanus Took, And Utterly Demolished It; And How Hyrcanus Joined Himself To The Sect Of The Sadducees, And Left That Of The Pharisees.
items.text_de: Wie Hyrkanos während des Streits zwischen Antiochos Grypos und Antiochos Kyzikenos um das Königreich Samaria einnahm und völlig zerstörte; und wie Hyrkanos sich der Partei der Sadduzäer anschloss und die der Pharisäer verließ.
items.text_en: How Upon The Quarrel Between Antiochus Grypus And Antiochus Cyzicenus About The Kingdom of samaria Hyrcanus Took, And Utterly Demolished It; And How Hyrcanus Joined Himself To The Sect Of The Sadducees, And Left That Of The Pharisees.

items.text: How Aristobulus, When He Had Taken The Government First Of All Put A Diadem On His Head, And Was Most Barbarously Cruel To His Mother And His Brethren; And How, After He Had Slain Antigonus, He Himself Died.
items.text_de: Wie Aristobulos, als er die Herrschaft übernommen hatte, als Erster ein Diadem aufsetzte und äußerst grausam gegen seine Mutter und seine Brüder vorging; und wie er, nachdem er Antigonos getötet hatte, selbst starb.
items.text_en: How Aristobulus, When He Had Taken The Government First Of All Put A Diadem On His Head, And Was Most Barbarously Cruel To His Mother And His Brethren; And How, After He Had Slain Antigonus, He Himself Died.

items.text: How Alexander When He Had Taken The Government Made An Expedition Against Ptolemais, And Then Raised The Siege Out Of Fear Of Ptolemy Lathyrus; And How Ptolemy Made War Against Him, Because He Had Sent To Cleopatra To Persuade Her To Make War Against Ptolemy, And Yet Pretended To Be In Friendship With Him, When He Beat The Jews In The Battle.
items.text_de: Wie Alexander, als er die Herrschaft übernommen hatte, einen Feldzug gegen Ptolemais unternahm und dann aus Furcht vor Ptolemaios Lathyros die Belagerung aufhob; und wie Ptolemaios Krieg gegen ihn führte, weil er zu Kleopatra geschickt hatte, um sie zum Krieg gegen Ptolemaios zu bewegen, und dennoch vorgab, mit ihm befreundet zu sein, wobei er die Juden in der Schlacht schlug.
items.text_en: How Alexander When He Had Taken The Government Made An Expedition Against Ptolemais, And Then Raised The Siege Out Of Fear Of Ptolemy Lathyrus; And How Ptolemy Made War Against Him, Because He Had Sent To Cleopatra To Persuade Her To Make War Against Ptolemy, And Yet Pretended To Be In Friendship With Him, When He Beat The Jews In The Battle.

items.text: How Alexander, upon the League of Mutual Defense Which Cleopatra Had Agreed with Him, Made an Expedition Against Coelesyria, and Utterly Overthrew the City of Gaza; and How He Slew Many Ten Thousands of Jews That Rebelled Against Him. Also Concerning Antiochus Grypus, Seleucus Antiochus Cyziceius, and Antiochus Pius, and Others.
items.text_de: Wie Alexander aufgrund des Bündnisses zur gegenseitigen Verteidigung, das Kleopatra mit ihm geschlossen hatte, einen Feldzug gegen Koilesyrien unternahm und die Stadt Gaza völlig zerstörte; und wie er viele Zehntausende Juden tötete, die sich gegen ihn erhoben hatten. Ferner über Antiochos Grypos, Seleukos, Antiochos Kyzikenos, Antiochos Pius und andere.
items.text_en: How Alexander, upon the League of Mutual Defense Which Cleopatra Had Agreed with Him, Made an Expedition Against Coelesyria, and Utterly Overthrew the City of Gaza; and How He Slew Many Ten Thousands of Jews That Rebelled Against Him. Also Concerning Antiochus Grypus, Seleucus Antiochus Cyziceius, and Antiochus Pius, and Others.

items.text: How Demetrius Eucerus Overcame Alexander And Yet In A Little Time Retired Out Of The Country For Fear; As Also How Alexander Slew Many Of The Jews And Thereby Got Clear Of His Troubles. Concerning The Death Of Demetrius.
items.text_de: Wie Demetrios Eukairos Alexander besiegte und sich doch nach kurzer Zeit aus Furcht aus dem Land zurückzog; und wie Alexander viele Juden tötete und dadurch seiner Schwierigkeiten ledig wurde. Über den Tod des Demetrios.
items.text_en: How Demetrius Eucerus Overcame Alexander And Yet In A Little Time Retired Out Of The Country For Fear; As Also How Alexander Slew Many Of The Jews And Thereby Got Clear Of His Troubles. Concerning The Death Of Demetrius.

items.text: How Antiochus, Who Was Called Dionysus, And After Him Aretas Made Expeditions Into Judea; As Also How Alexander Took Many Cities And Then Returned To Jerusalem, And After A Sickness Of Three Years Died; And What Counsel He Gave To Alexandra.
items.text_de: Wie Antiochos, der Dionysos genannt wurde, und nach ihm Aretas Feldzüge nach Judäa unternahmen; und wie Alexander viele Städte einnahm, dann nach Jerusalem zurückkehrte und nach dreijähriger Krankheit starb; und welchen Rat er Alexandra gab.
items.text_en: How Antiochus, Who Was Called Dionysus, And After Him Aretas Made Expeditions Into Judea; As Also How Alexander Took Many Cities And Then Returned To Jerusalem, And After A Sickness Of Three Years Died; And What Counsel He Gave To Alexandra.

items.text: How Alexandra By Gaining The Good-Will Of The Pharisees, Retained The Kingdom Nine Years, And Then, Having Done Many Glorious Actions Died.
items.text_de: Wie Alexandra, indem sie das Wohlwollen der Pharisäer gewann, das Königreich neun Jahre lang behielt und dann, nachdem sie viele ruhmreiche Taten vollbracht hatte, starb.
items.text_en: How Alexandra By Gaining The Good-Will Of The Pharisees, Retained The Kingdom Nine Years, And Then, Having Done Many Glorious Actions Died.

items.text: The War Between Aristobulus And Hyrcanus About The Kingdom; And How They Made An agreement That Aristobulus Should Be King, And Hyrcanus Live A Private Life; As Also How Hyrcanus A Little Afterward Was Persuaded By Antipater To Fly To Aretas.
items.text_de: Der Krieg zwischen Aristobulos und Hyrkanos um das Königreich und wie sie vereinbarten, dass Aristobulos König sein und Hyrkanos als Privatmann leben solle; und wie Hyrkanos wenig später von Antipatros überredet wurde, zu Aretas zu fliehen.
items.text_en: The War Between Aristobulus And Hyrcanus About The Kingdom; And How They Made An agreement That Aristobulus Should Be King, And Hyrcanus Live A Private Life; As Also How Hyrcanus A Little Afterward Was Persuaded By Antipater To Fly To Aretas.

items.text: How Aretas And Hyrcanus Made An Expedition Against Aristobulus And Besieged Jerusalem; And How Scaurus The Roman General Raised The Siege. Concerning The Death Of Onias.
items.text_de: Wie Aretas und Hyrkanos einen Feldzug gegen Aristobulos unternahmen und Jerusalem belagerten und wie der römische Feldherr Scaurus die Belagerung aufhob. Über den Tod des Onias.
items.text_en: How Aretas And Hyrcanus Made An Expedition Against Aristobulus And Besieged Jerusalem; And How Scaurus The Roman General Raised The Siege. Concerning The Death Of Onias.

items.text: How Aristobulus And Hyrcanus Came To Pompey In Order To Argue Who Ought To Have The Kingdom; And How Upon The Plight Of Aristobulus To The Fortress Alexandrium Pompey Led His Army Against Him And Ordered Him To Deliver Up The Fortresses Whereof He Was Possessed.
items.text_de: Wie Aristobulos und Hyrkanos zu Pompeius kamen, um darüber zu streiten, wem das Königreich zustehe; und wie Pompeius nach der Flucht des Aristobulos in die Festung Alexandreion sein Heer gegen ihn führte und ihm befahl, die Festungen, die er besaß, auszuliefern.
items.text_en: How Aristobulus And Hyrcanus Came To Pompey In Order To Argue Who Ought To Have The Kingdom; And How Upon The Plight Of Aristobulus To The Fortress Alexandrium Pompey Led His Army Against Him And Ordered Him To Deliver Up The Fortresses Whereof He Was Possessed.

items.text: How Pompey When The Citizens Of Jerusalem Shut Their Gates Against Him Besieged The City And Took It By Force; As Also What Other Things He Did In Judea.
items.text_de: Wie Pompeius, als die Bürger Jerusalems ihm die Tore verschlossen, die Stadt belagerte und mit Gewalt einnahm; und was er sonst noch in Judäa tat.
items.text_en: How Pompey When The Citizens Of Jerusalem Shut Their Gates Against Him Besieged The City And Took It By Force; As Also What Other Things He Did In Judea.

items.text: How Scaurus Made A League Of Mutual Assistance With Aretas; And What Gabinius Did In Judea, After He Had Conquered Alexander, The Son Of Aristobulus.
items.text_de: Wie Scaurus mit Aretas ein Bündnis zur gegenseitigen Unterstützung schloss und was Gabinius in Judäa tat, nachdem er Alexander, den Sohn des Aristobulos, besiegt hatte.
items.text_en: How Scaurus Made A League Of Mutual Assistance With Aretas; And What Gabinius Did In Judea, After He Had Conquered Alexander, The Son Of Aristobulus.

items.text: How Gabinius Caught Aristobulus After He Had Fled From Rome, And Sent Him Back To Rome Again; And Now The Same Gabinius As He Returned Out Of Egypt Overcame Alexander And The Nabateans In Battle.
items.text_de: Wie Gabinius Aristobulos ergriff, nachdem dieser aus Rom geflohen war, und ihn wieder nach Rom zurückschickte; und wie derselbe Gabinius auf seiner Rückkehr aus Ägypten Alexander und die Nabatäer in der Schlacht besiegte.
items.text_en: How Gabinius Caught Aristobulus After He Had Fled From Rome, And Sent Him Back To Rome Again; And Now The Same Gabinius As He Returned Out Of Egypt Overcame Alexander And The Nabateans In Battle.

items.text: How Crassus Came Into Judea, And Pillaged The Temple; And Then Marched Against The Parthians And Perished, With His Army. Also How Cassius Obtained Syria, And Put A Stop To The Parthians And Then Went Up To Judea.
items.text_de: Wie Crassus nach Judäa kam und den Tempel plünderte, dann gegen die Parther zog und mit seinem Heer umkam. Ferner wie Cassius Syrien in seine Gewalt brachte, den Parthern Einhalt gebot und dann nach Judäa hinaufzog.
items.text_en: How Crassus Came Into Judea, And Pillaged The Temple; And Then Marched Against The Parthians And Perished, With His Army. Also How Cassius Obtained Syria, And Put A Stop To The Parthians And Then Went Up To Judea.

items.text: The Jews Become Confederates With Caesar When He Fought Against Egypt. The Glorious Actions Of Antipater, And His Friendship With Caesar. The Honors Which The Jews Received From The Romans And Athenians.
items.text_de: Die Juden werden Verbündete Caesars, als er gegen Ägypten kämpfte. Die ruhmreichen Taten des Antipatros und seine Freundschaft mit Caesar. Die Ehrungen, die die Juden von den Römern und den Athenern empfingen.
items.text_en: The Jews Become Confederates With Caesar When He Fought Against Egypt. The Glorious Actions Of Antipater, And His Friendship With Caesar. The Honors Which The Jews Received From The Romans And Athenians.

items.text: How Antipater Committed The Care Of Galilee To Herod, And That Of Jerusalem To Phasaelus; As Also How Herod Upon The Jews' Envy At Antipater Was Accused Before Hyrcanus.
items.text_de: Wie Antipatros die Sorge für Galiläa Herodes und die für Jerusalem Phasael übertrug; und wie Herodes infolge des Neides der Juden auf Antipatros vor Hyrkanos angeklagt wurde.
items.text_en: How Antipater Committed The Care Of Galilee To Herod, And That Of Jerusalem To Phasaelus; As Also How Herod Upon The Jews' Envy At Antipater Was Accused Before Hyrcanus.

items.text: The Honors That Were Paid The Jews; And The Leagues That Were Made By The Romans And Other Nations, With Them.
items.text_de: Die Ehrungen, die den Juden erwiesen wurden, und die Bündnisse, die die Römer und andere Völker mit ihnen schlossen.
items.text_en: The Honors That Were Paid The Jews; And The Leagues That Were Made By The Romans And Other Nations, With Them.

items.text: How Marcus, Succeeded Sextus When He Had Been Slain By Bassus's Treachery; And How, After The Death Of Caesar, Cassius Came Into Syria, And Distressed Judea; As Also How Malichus Slew Antipater And Was Himself Slain By Herod.
items.text_de: Wie Marcus die Nachfolge des Sextus antrat, als dieser durch den Verrat des Bassus getötet worden war; und wie Cassius nach dem Tod Caesars nach Syrien kam und Judäa bedrängte; und wie Malichos Antipatros tötete und selbst von Herodes getötet wurde.
items.text_en: How Marcus, Succeeded Sextus When He Had Been Slain By Bassus's Treachery; And How, After The Death Of Caesar, Cassius Came Into Syria, And Distressed Judea; As Also How Malichus Slew Antipater And Was Himself Slain By Herod.

items.text: Herod Ejects Antigonus, The Son Of Aristobulus Out Of Judea, And Gains The Friendship Of Antony, Who Was Now Come Into Syria, By Sending Him Much Money; On Which Account He Would Not Admit Of Those That Would Have Accused Herod: And What It Was That Antony Wrote To The Tyrians In Behalf .
items.text_de: Herodes vertreibt Antigonos, den Sohn des Aristobulos, aus Judäa und gewinnt die Freundschaft des Antonius, der inzwischen nach Syrien gekommen war, indem er ihm viel Geld schickt; aus diesem Grund ließ dieser die nicht vor, die Herodes anklagen wollten. Und was Antonius den Tyrern zugunsten [der Juden] schrieb.
items.text_en: Herod Ejects Antigonus, The Son Of Aristobulus Out Of Judea, And Gains The Friendship Of Antony, Who Was Now Come Into Syria, By Sending Him Much Money; On Which Account He Would Not Admit Of Those That Would Have Accused Herod: And What It Was That Antony Wrote To The Tyrians In Behalf .

items.text: How Antony Made Herod And Phasaelus Tetrarchs, After They Had Been Accused To No Purpose; And How The Parthians When They Brought Antigonus Into Judea Took Hyrcanus And Phasaelus Captives. Herod's Flight; And What Afflictions Hyrcanus And Phasaelus Endured.
items.text_de: Wie Antonius Herodes und Phasael zu Tetrarchen machte, nachdem man sie vergeblich angeklagt hatte; und wie die Parther, als sie Antigonos nach Judäa brachten, Hyrkanos und Phasael gefangen nahmen. Die Flucht des Herodes und welche Leiden Hyrkanos und Phasael erduldeten.
items.text_en: How Antony Made Herod And Phasaelus Tetrarchs, After They Had Been Accused To No Purpose; And How The Parthians When They Brought Antigonus Into Judea Took Hyrcanus And Phasaelus Captives. Herod's Flight; And What Afflictions Hyrcanus And Phasaelus Endured.

items.text: How Herod Got Away From The King Of Arabia And Made Haste To Go Into Egypt And Thence Went Away In Haste Also To Rome; And How, By Promising A Great Deal Of Money To Antony He Obtained Of The Senate And Of Caesar To Be Made King Of The Jews.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes dem König von Arabien entkam, eilends nach Ägypten zog und von dort ebenfalls in Eile nach Rom reiste; und wie er, indem er Antonius viel Geld versprach, vom Senat und von Caesar erlangte, zum König der Juden ernannt zu werden.
items.text_en: How Herod Got Away From The King Of Arabia And Made Haste To Go Into Egypt And Thence Went Away In Haste Also To Rome; And How, By Promising A Great Deal Of Money To Antony He Obtained Of The Senate And Of Caesar To Be Made King Of The Jews.

items.text: How Herod Sailed Out Of Italy To Judea, And Fought With Antigonus And What Other Things Happened In Judea About That Time.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes von Italien nach Judäa segelte und mit Antigonos kämpfte und was sich um diese Zeit sonst in Judäa ereignete.
items.text_en: How Herod Sailed Out Of Italy To Judea, And Fought With Antigonus And What Other Things Happened In Judea About That Time.

items.text: How Herod, When He Had Married Mariamne Took Jerusalem With The Assistance Of Sosius By Force; And How The Government Of Heasamoneans Was Put An End To
items.text_de: Wie Herodes, nachdem er Mariamne geheiratet hatte, Jerusalem mit Hilfe des Sosius gewaltsam einnahm und wie der Herrschaft der Hasmonäer ein Ende gesetzt wurde.
items.text_en: How Herod, When He Had Married Mariamne Took Jerusalem With The Assistance Of Sosius By Force; And How The Government Of Heasamoneans Was Put An End To

items.text: Concerning Pollio And Sameas. Herod Slays The Principal Of Antigonus's Friends, And Spoils The City Of Its Wealth. Antony Beheads Antigonus.
items.text_de: Über Pollio und Sameas. Herodes tötet die vornehmsten Freunde des Antigonos und beraubt die Stadt ihres Reichtums. Antonius lässt Antigonos enthaupten.
items.text_en: Concerning Pollio And Sameas. Herod Slays The Principal Of Antigonus's Friends, And Spoils The City Of Its Wealth. Antony Beheads Antigonus.

items.text: How Hyrcanus Was Set At Liberty By The Parthians, And Returned To Herod; And What Alexandra Did When She Heard That Ananelus Was Made High Priest.
items.text_de: Wie Hyrkanos von den Parthern freigelassen wurde und zu Herodes zurückkehrte; und was Alexandra tat, als sie hörte, dass Ananel zum Hohepriester gemacht worden war.
items.text_en: How Hyrcanus Was Set At Liberty By The Parthians, And Returned To Herod; And What Alexandra Did When She Heard That Ananelus Was Made High Priest.

items.text: How Herod Upon His Making Aristobulus High Priest Took Care That He Should Be Murdered In A Little Time; And What Apology He Made To Antony About Aristobulus; As Also Concerning Joseph And Mariamne.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes, nachdem er Aristobulos zum Hohepriester gemacht hatte, dafür sorgte, dass dieser binnen kurzem ermordet wurde; und welche Rechtfertigung er Antonius gegenüber wegen Aristobulos vorbrachte; ferner über Joseph und Mariamne.
items.text_en: How Herod Upon His Making Aristobulus High Priest Took Care That He Should Be Murdered In A Little Time; And What Apology He Made To Antony About Aristobulus; As Also Concerning Joseph And Mariamne.

items.text: How Cleopatra, When She Had Gotten From Antony Some Parts Of Judea And Arabia Came Into Judea; And How Herod Gave Her Many Presents And Conducted Her On Her Way Back To Egypt.
items.text_de: Wie Kleopatra, nachdem sie von Antonius einige Teile Judäas und Arabiens erhalten hatte, nach Judäa kam; und wie Herodes ihr viele Geschenke machte und sie auf ihrem Rückweg nach Ägypten geleitete.
items.text_en: How Cleopatra, When She Had Gotten From Antony Some Parts Of Judea And Arabia Came Into Judea; And How Herod Gave Her Many Presents And Conducted Her On Her Way Back To Egypt.

items.text: How Herod Made War With The King Of Arabia, And After They Had Fought Many Battles, At Length Conquered Him, And Was Chosen By The Arabs To Be Governor Of That Nation; As Also Concerning A Great Earthquake.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes Krieg mit dem König von Arabien führte und ihn nach vielen Schlachten schließlich besiegte und von den Arabern zum Herrscher über dieses Volk gewählt wurde; ferner über ein großes Erdbeben.
items.text_en: How Herod Made War With The King Of Arabia, And After They Had Fought Many Battles, At Length Conquered Him, And Was Chosen By The Arabs To Be Governor Of That Nation; As Also Concerning A Great Earthquake.

items.text: How Herod Slew Hyrcanus And Then Hasted Away To Caesar, And Obtained The Kingdom From Him Also; And How A Little Time Afterward, He Entertained Caesar In A Most Honorable Manner.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes Hyrkanos tötete, dann eilends zu Caesar reiste und auch von ihm das Königreich erhielt; und wie er wenig später Caesar auf das Ehrenvollste bewirtete.
items.text_en: How Herod Slew Hyrcanus And Then Hasted Away To Caesar, And Obtained The Kingdom From Him Also; And How A Little Time Afterward, He Entertained Caesar In A Most Honorable Manner.

items.text: How Herod Slew Sohemus And Mariamne And Afterward Alexandra And Costobarus, And His Most Intimate Friends, And At Last The Sons Of Babbas Also.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes Soemos und Mariamne und danach Alexandra und Kostobaros sowie seine engsten Freunde und schließlich auch die Söhne des Baba töten ließ.
items.text_en: How Herod Slew Sohemus And Mariamne And Afterward Alexandra And Costobarus, And His Most Intimate Friends, And At Last The Sons Of Babbas Also.

items.text: How Ten Men Of The Citizens [Of Jerusalem] Made A Conspiracy Against Herod, For The Foreign Practices He Had Introduced, Which Was A Transgression Of The Laws Of Their Country. Concerning The Building Of Sebaste And Cesarea, And Other Edifices Of Herod.
items.text_de: Wie zehn Bürger [Jerusalems] sich gegen Herodes verschworen wegen der fremden Bräuche, die er eingeführt hatte und die eine Übertretung der Gesetze ihres Landes waren. Über den Bau von Sebaste und Caesarea und andere Bauwerke des Herodes.
items.text_en: How Ten Men Of The Citizens [Of Jerusalem] Made A Conspiracy Against Herod, For The Foreign Practices He Had Introduced, Which Was A Transgression Of The Laws Of Their Country. Concerning The Building Of Sebaste And Cesarea, And Other Edifices Of Herod.

items.text: Concerning The Famine That Happened In Judea And Syria; And How Herod, After He Had Married Another Wife, Rebuilt Cesarea, And Other Grecian Cities.
items.text_de: Über die Hungersnot, die in Judäa und Syrien herrschte; und wie Herodes, nachdem er eine weitere Frau geheiratet hatte, Caesarea und andere griechische Städte neu erbaute.
items.text_en: Concerning The Famine That Happened In Judea And Syria; And How Herod, After He Had Married Another Wife, Rebuilt Cesarea, And Other Grecian Cities.

items.text: How Herod Sent His Sons To Rome; How Also He Was Accused By Zenodorus And The Gadarens, But Was Cleared Of What They Accused Him Of And Withal Gained To Himself The Good-Will Of Caesar. Concerning The Pharisees, The Essens And Manahem.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes seine Söhne nach Rom schickte; ferner wie er von Zenodoros und den Gadarenern angeklagt, aber von ihren Anschuldigungen freigesprochen wurde und dabei zugleich das Wohlwollen Caesars gewann. Über die Pharisäer, die Essener und Menahem.
items.text_en: How Herod Sent His Sons To Rome; How Also He Was Accused By Zenodorus And The Gadarens, But Was Cleared Of What They Accused Him Of And Withal Gained To Himself The Good-Will Of Caesar. Concerning The Pharisees, The Essens And Manahem.

items.text: How Herod Rebuilt The Temple And Raised It Higher And Made It More Magnificent Than It Was Before; As Also Concerning That Tower Which He Called Antonia.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes den Tempel neu erbaute, ihn höher aufführte und prächtiger machte, als er zuvor gewesen war; ferner über den Turm, den er Antonia nannte.
items.text_en: How Herod Rebuilt The Temple And Raised It Higher And Made It More Magnificent Than It Was Before; As Also Concerning That Tower Which He Called Antonia.

items.text: A Law Of Herod's About, Thieves. Salome And Pheroras Calumniate Alexander And Aristobulus, Upon Their Return From Rome For Whom Yet Herod Provides Wives.
items.text_de: Ein Gesetz des Herodes über Diebe. Salome und Pheroras verleumden Alexander und Aristobulos nach deren Rückkehr aus Rom, für die Herodes dennoch Ehefrauen besorgt.
items.text_en: A Law Of Herod's About, Thieves. Salome And Pheroras Calumniate Alexander And Aristobulus, Upon Their Return From Rome For Whom Yet Herod Provides Wives.

items.text: How Herod Twice Sailed To Agrippa; And How Upon The Complaint In Ionia Against The Greeks Agrippa Confirmed The Laws To Them.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes zweimal zu Agrippa segelte und wie Agrippa auf die Klage in Ionien gegen die Griechen hin ihnen ihre Gesetze bestätigte.
items.text_en: How Herod Twice Sailed To Agrippa; And How Upon The Complaint In Ionia Against The Greeks Agrippa Confirmed The Laws To Them.

items.text: How Great Disturbances Arose In Herods Family On His Preferring Antipater His Eldest Son Before The Rest, Till Alexander Took That Injury Very Heinously.
items.text_de: Wie große Unruhen in der Familie des Herodes entstanden, weil er Antipatros, seinen ältesten Sohn, den übrigen vorzog, bis Alexander diese Kränkung sehr schwer nahm.
items.text_en: How Great Disturbances Arose In Herods Family On His Preferring Antipater His Eldest Son Before The Rest, Till Alexander Took That Injury Very Heinously.

items.text: How During Antipater's Abode At Rome, Herod Brought Alexander And Aristobulus Before Caesar And Accused Them. Alexander's Defense Of Himself Before Caesar And Reconciliation To His Father.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes während des Aufenthalts des Antipatros in Rom Alexander und Aristobulos vor Caesar brachte und sie anklagte. Alexanders Verteidigung vor Caesar und seine Versöhnung mit seinem Vater.
items.text_en: How During Antipater's Abode At Rome, Herod Brought Alexander And Aristobulus Before Caesar And Accused Them. Alexander's Defense Of Himself Before Caesar And Reconciliation To His Father.

items.text: How Herod Celebrated The Games That Were To Return Every Fifth Year Upon The Building Of Cesarea; And How He Built And Adorned Many Other Places After A Magnificent Manner; And Did Many Other Actions Gloriously
items.text_de: Wie Herodes anlässlich der Erbauung Caesareas die Spiele feierte, die alle fünf Jahre wiederkehren sollten; und wie er viele andere Orte auf prächtige Weise erbaute und schmückte und viele andere ruhmreiche Taten vollbrachte.
items.text_en: How Herod Celebrated The Games That Were To Return Every Fifth Year Upon The Building Of Cesarea; And How He Built And Adorned Many Other Places After A Magnificent Manner; And Did Many Other Actions Gloriously

items.text: An Embassage In Cyrene And Asia To Caesar, Concerning The Complaints They Had To Make Against The Greeks; With Copies Of The Epistles Which Caesar And Agrippa Wrote To The Cities For Them.
items.text_de: Eine Gesandtschaft aus Kyrene und Asien an Caesar wegen der Klagen, die sie gegen die Griechen vorzubringen hatten; mit Abschriften der Briefe, die Caesar und Agrippa für sie an die Städte schrieben.
items.text_en: An Embassage In Cyrene And Asia To Caesar, Concerning The Complaints They Had To Make Against The Greeks; With Copies Of The Epistles Which Caesar And Agrippa Wrote To The Cities For Them.

items.text: How, Upon Herod's Going Down Into David's Sepulcher, The Sedition In His Family Greatly Increased.
items.text_de: Wie der Aufruhr in seiner Familie stark zunahm, nachdem Herodes in das Grab Davids hinabgestiegen war.
items.text_en: How, Upon Herod's Going Down Into David's Sepulcher, The Sedition In His Family Greatly Increased.

items.text: How Herod Took Up Alexander And Bound Him; Whom Yet Archelaus King Of Cappadocia Reconciled To His Father Herod Again.
items.text_de: Wie Herodes Alexander ergreifen und fesseln ließ, den jedoch Archelaos, der König von Kappadokien, wieder mit seinem Vater Herodes versöhnte.
items.text_en: How Herod Took Up Alexander And Bound Him; Whom Yet Archelaus King Of Cappadocia Reconciled To His Father Herod Again.

items.text: How Antipater Was Hated By All The Nation [Of The Jews] For The Slaughter Of His Brethren; And How, For That Reason He Got Into Peculiar Favor With His Friends At Rome, By Giving Them Many Presents; As He Did Also With Saturninus, The President Of Syria And The Governors Who Were Under Him; And Concerning Herod's Wives And Children.
items.text_de: Wie Antipatros vom ganzen Volk [der Juden] wegen der Ermordung seiner Brüder gehasst wurde und wie er sich aus diesem Grund durch viele Geschenke bei seinen Freunden in Rom besondere Gunst verschaffte, ebenso bei Saturninus, dem Statthalter Syriens, und den ihm unterstellten Befehlshabern; und über die Frauen und Kinder des Herodes.

items.text: Pheroras's Wife Is Accused By His Freedmen, As Guilty Of Poisoning Him; And How Herod, Upon Examining; Of The Matter By Torture Found The Poison; But So That It Had Been Prepared For Himself By His Son Antipater; And Upon An Inquiry By Torture He Discovered The Dangerous Designs Of Antipater.

items.text: Antipater's Navigation From Rome To His Father; And How He Was Accused By Nicolaus Of Damascus And Condemned To Die By His Father, And By Quintilius Varus, Who Was Then President Of Syria; And How He Was Then Bound Till Caesar Should Be Informed Of His Cause.
